name: cc
description: A fast cc CLI for switching between Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor Agent.

scripts.check: node --check src/cc.mjs && node --check src/pi-harness.mjs && node --check scripts/postinstall.mjs && for f in src/harness/*.mjs src/harness/adapters/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -c "import pathlib; files=list(pathlib.Path('src/harnesses').rglob('*.py'))+[pathlib.Path('tests/e2e_harness_bridges.py')]; [compile(path.read_text(), str(path), 'exec') for path in files]"
scripts.test: npm run check && node tests/settings.test.mjs && node tests/codex_features.test.mjs && node tests/codex_thread.test.mjs && node tests/codex_fork.test.mjs && node tests/codex_management.test.mjs && node tests/codex_apps.test.mjs && node tests/codex_native_ui.test.mjs && node tests/codex_feedback_app.test.mjs && node tests/codex_memory.test.mjs && node tests/codex_import.test.mjs && node tests/codex_config_report.test.mjs && node tests/codex_parity_ui.test.mjs && node tests/elicitation.test.mjs && node tests/permissions.test.mjs && node tests/harness_adapter.test.mjs && node tests/postinstall.test.mjs && python3 -c "compile(open('tests/fake_acp.py').read(), 'tests/fake_acp.py', 'exec')" && bash tests/permission_auto_smoke.sh && bash tests/permission_persist_smoke.sh && bash tests/tui_smoke.sh
